art_note: Clean studio presentation with standard e-commerce clarity, lacking high-fashion cinematic mood.
desc_en: Tailored silhouette defining an impeccable presence. This design features a sophisticated pleated front and clean lines to project serene confidence. Crafted with precision to offer a flawless drape and lasting comfort in any professional or social setting. Each piece is made to order with worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Silueta sastrera entallada que define una presencia impecable. Este diseño presenta un sofisticado frente plisado y líneas limpias para proyectar una seguridad serena. Confeccionado con precisión para ofrecer una caída perfecta y una comodidad duradera en cualquier entorno profesional o social. Cada pieza se confecciona bajo pedido con envíos a todo el mundo.
details_en:
· 95% polyester, 5% elastane (260 g/m²)
· Tailored silhouette
· Pleated front
· Zip fly with contrast button closure
· Front pockets and buttoned back pockets
· Made to order with worldwide shipping
details_es:
